codeReview.summary: The feature commit adds explicit callback parameter types across the targeted files and generally satisfies VAL-TYPE-006, but it does not fully complete the intended callback typing sweep because at least one callback in the touched scope still uses an implicit parameter type.

issues.description: The callback typing sweep is incomplete: `(def.models || []).map((m) => ({ ... }))` still leaves `m` implicitly typed in a feature-targeted file. This falls short of the feature description ('Fix 20+ implicit any callbacks in forEach/map/filter') and VAL-TYPE-006's requirement that the reviewed array callbacks be explicitly typed.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The `refactor-worker` skill does not describe how to handle verification-only sessions when the assigned feature is already implemented on the branch, so the worker had to mark `followedProcedure` false despite doing the right thing by auditing the landed commit and validators.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: /Users/sero/projects/browser-ai/.factory/skills/refactor-worker/SKILL.md assumes the worker will refactor code and write tests first, while handoff `2026-03-28T10-28-17-882Z__fix-callback-types__92824890-11ea-410c-8c1c-ea14ac51a0e0.json` records deviations because commit `f455a83ac9128423b50eb4f77b4067ca56e0fe8a` was already present and the worker correctly switched to audit/verification work.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Mission guidance and the skill disagree about repo-standards validation in debt-heavy repos: the mission AGENTS file already documents unrelated oversized-file failures, but the skill still frames full repo-standards as mandatory unless workers infer a scoped fallback on their own.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Mission AGENTS.md says `npm run check:repo-standards` fails on unrelated oversized files, while `.factory/skills/refactor-worker/SKILL.md` step 8 still lists the global check as part of the standard completion path. The callback-types handoff records that `npm run check:repo-standards` failed only for unrelated baseline debt.
